title: Pg Dump In Practice
summary: Custom format dumps give selective pg_restore, compression, object ordering, and parallel restore. A practical dump records the database, role assumptions, extension inventory, restore command, row-count checks, and the known query that proves business data survived.
learning_objectives: Explain the operational purpose of Pg Dump In Practice.
Collect PostgreSQL evidence before proposing remediation.
Describe verification and rollback for the administrative action.
reflection_prompts: What evidence would you attach to an incident review?
Which part of the remediation has the largest operational blast radius?
